title: Codimension-one Cartier part of a subscheme on a regular surface
statement: Let $X$ be an integral regular Noetherian scheme of dimension $2$, and let $Z\subsetneq X$ be a closed subscheme with ideal $\mathcal I_Z$. There exist an effective Cartier ideal $\mathcal L\subseteq\mathcal O_X$ and a finite-type quasi-coherent ideal $\mathcal J\subseteq\mathcal O_X$ such that $\mathcal I_Z=\mathcal L\mathcal J$, and $T=\operatorname{Supp}(\mathcal O_X/\mathcal J)$ is a finite set of closed points of codimension $2$ contained in $|Z|$. Here codimension of a point is the dimension of its local ring. The empty set $T$ and the unit ideal $\mathcal L=\mathcal O_X$ are allowed. Conventions: [def-pc-integral-scheme], [def-weil-regular-scheme], [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring], [def-weil-closed-immersion], [def-nagata-effective-cartier-ideal], [pqf-def-coherent].
